findings.detail: The free-end nearest-neighbor matrix plus positive pinning is positive definite. With unit mass and independent gamma=.4 thermal baths, the full drift/noise and modal covariance have consistent factors2gammaT. The minimum modal squared frequency remains above gamma²/4 over the proposed stiffness/coupling box, so the real underdamped formula is valid there.

Weak single scattering and phase-stable heterodyne measurement of both quadratures specify A_q and Re<A_q(t)A_q(0)*> including its mean. The pair phase,1/N normalization and displacement-difference Gaussian variance in the oracle agree with that observable. Finite-delay real correlations may be negative; that does not violate spectral positivity.

The source keeps the exact static field variance, disconnected elastic field and tagged-particle relaxation, but replaces collective connected dynamics by normalized self relaxation. Fs−Fs_infinity is a positive-semidefinite stationary covariance kernel; scaling by nonnegative S−F_infinity and adding a nonnegative constant gives a coherent alternative field-correlation model. It need not be realized by the specified microscopic array. This is a collective relaxation approximation, not a malformed Gaussian identity.

The active positive bath and pinning make the OU dynamics mixing, hence F_infinity=|<A>|². The rejected isolated finite array would recur and does not justify this plateau. The final proposed apparatus states the bath remains active throughout observation.

At zero delay the source is exactly static. At zero coupling the particles are independent and identical, so the distinct contribution is time independent and the normalized self correction is exact at all delays. At reciprocal q all static spatial phases are+1; every nonzero displacement-difference variance gives a strictly positive derivative with K. These records identify K globally, while finite-delay independent-particle records also constrain dynamic implementation.

The independent10D drift, stationary Lyapunov covariance and full matrix exponential do not reuse the scalar modal time law. Pairwise2D Hermite integration directly averages the field phase instead of reusing the oracle characteristic-function expression. Both use the same explicitly linear Gaussian apparatus, as they should. This is independent numerical implementation, not independent microscopic stochastic sampling.

All160 saved reference cases,272 full q/time scan rows and25 inverse fits are preserved. Reciprocal-wavevector delays1.25–1.5 give healthy full-field signals and15% or larger closure gaps at the nine checked K/T settings. This is bounded evidence; continuous/interior checks and256-noise/local controls remain future package work.
